subject: general
question: What does the word "masquerade" means?

options.text: To dress up for a party
To pretend to be someone else

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. to pretend to be someone else.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"masquerade"** means:

 
 
• To pretend to be someone one is not; to disguise oneself. (छलावरण)
 
 
 
• In the context of the options provided, "masquerade" refers to the act of pretending to be someone else.
 
• **Example:** He decided to masquerade as a detective to gather more information.

Therefore, the correct meaning of "masquerade" is: **to pretend to be someone else.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To dress up for a party** (पार्टी के लिए कपड़े पहनना): To wear special or formal clothes for a social event.

 
 
• **Example:** She dressed up for the costume party as her favorite movie character.
 
 
 
• **To disappear suddenly** (अचानक गायब होना): To vanish or go away quickly and without warning.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician made the rabbit disappear suddenly during his performance.
 
 
 
• **To ask for a favor** (एक एहसान मांगना): To request help or assistance from someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He asked his colleague for a favor to cover his shift.
